records.jp: ここでの暮らしも、もう終わりか……
records.en_original: Our time here is already coming to an end...
records.en_auxiliary: Our time here is already coming to an end...
records.en: Our time here is already coming to an end...

records.jp: そうだね……
records.en_original: I guess so...
records.en_auxiliary: I guess so...
records.en: I guess so...

records.jp: 長いようで短い人生だった
records.en_original: It's been a long, yet short life.
records.en_auxiliary: It's been a long, yet short life.
records.en: It was a life both long and short.

records.jp: ……きらら、それじゃ死ぬみたいだよ？
records.en_original: You make it sound like we're dying, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: You make it sound like we're dying, Kirara.
records.en: You make it sound like we're dying, Kirara.

records.jp: ……む、たしかに。では、こうしよう
records.en_original: Hmm, that's true... How about this.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, that's true... How about this.
records.en: Hm, true. Then let's put it this way.

records.jp: この世界での生活は、刺激に満ち溢れていて……<CR>あっという間に過ぎ去っていった
records.en_original: Life in this world was so full of excitement... It all went by so quickly.
records.en_auxiliary: Life in this world was so full of excitement... It all went by so quickly.
records.en: Life in this world was filled with excitement...<CR>and passed in no time.

records.jp: 目の前にはゴールがある。<CR>振り返れば、ここまで歩いてきた道のりがある
records.en_original: Our goal is right in front of us. If we look back, we can see the path that led us here.
records.en_auxiliary: Our goal is right in front of us. If we look back, we can see the path that led us here.
records.en: The goal lies before us.<CR>Behind us is the road we've walked to get here.

records.jp: 愛央は、どうだった？<CR>ここまでの道のりは、満足いくものだったか？
records.en_original: Tell me Ao, are you satisfied with your journey thus far?
records.en_auxiliary: Tell me Ao, are you satisfied with your journey thus far?
records.en: How was it for you, Ao?<CR>Are you satisfied with the road you've traveled?

records.jp: どうかな……。<CR>全部が全部完璧だったとは、さすがに思わないけど……
records.en_original: I don't know... I wouldn't say everything was perfect.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know... I wouldn't say everything was perfect.
records.en: I don't know...<CR>I wouldn't say everything was perfect.

records.jp: やれることはやったんじゃないかって思う。<CR>私にできることは、やり通せた
records.en_original: But I think I did what I could.
records.en_auxiliary: But I think I did what I could.
records.en: I think I did everything I could.<CR>I followed through on everything within my power.

records.jp: でも、どうしてそんなことを？
records.en_original: But why do you bring it up?
records.en_auxiliary: But why do you bring it up?
records.en: But why ask that?

records.jp: もうすぐ世界が再構築される。<CR>その世界が、きららたちの望む世界になるかどうか――
records.en_original: The world will be rebuilt soon. Whether or not it will be rebuilt the way I want it...
records.en_auxiliary: The world will be rebuilt soon. Whether or not it will be rebuilt the way I want it...
records.en: The world will soon be rebuilt.<CR>Whether it becomes the world Kirara and the others desire—

records.jp: すべては、きららたちの想いにかかっている
records.en_original: It all depends on our emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: It all depends on our emotions.
records.en: Everything depends on Kirara and the others' feelings.

records.jp: ……うん。責任重大だね
records.en_original: Yeah... It's a big responsibility.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... It's a big responsibility.
records.en: Yeah... It's a big responsibility.

records.jp: だから、これまでのことを思い返していた。<CR>これまで歩んできた道のりはどうだったか、と
records.en_original: That's why I was reflecting on what I had done so far. I thought how I came here.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I was reflecting on what I had done so far. I thought how I came here.
records.en: That's why Kirara was looking back on everything—<CR>wondering what the road we've walked was like.

records.jp: そっか。元の世界の思い出が、<CR>私たちを新しい世界に連れていってくれるから……
records.en_original: The memories of the old world are what will take us to the new world, after all...
records.en_auxiliary: The memories of the old world are what will take us to the new world, after all...
records.en: I see. The memories of the old world<CR>will carry us to the new one...

records.jp: うむ
records.en_original: Right.
records.en_auxiliary: Right.
records.en: Indeed.

records.jp: きららは、どうだった？<CR>満足のいく道のりだった？
records.en_original: How about you, Kirara? Are you satisfied with your journey?
records.en_auxiliary: How about you, Kirara? Are you satisfied with your journey?
records.en: How about you, Kirara?<CR>Are you satisfied with your journey?

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: きららは、神の声を聞くことはできても、<CR>自分では何も成し遂げられなかった
records.en_original: Even with the Divine, I was never able to accomplish anything on my own.
records.en_auxiliary: Even with the Divine, I was never able to accomplish anything on my own.
records.en: Kirara could hear the Divine's voice,<CR>but could accomplish nothing herself.

records.jp: 今こうして未来に希望を持てるのは……<CR>愛央や、他のみんながいてくれたからだ
records.en_original: You and the others are the ones who gave me hope for the future.
records.en_auxiliary: You and the others are the ones who gave me hope for the future.
records.en: Kirara can hope for the future now<CR>because Ao and everyone else were here.

records.jp: きらら一人では、何もできなかった。<CR>だから、満足と言っていいのか……
records.en_original: I don't know if I can be satisfied when I did nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if I can be satisfied when I did nothing.
records.en: Kirara could do nothing alone.<CR>So can Kirara truly say she is satisfied...?

records.jp: いいんだよ
records.en_original: Of course you can.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course you can.
records.en: Of course you can.

records.jp: それを言ったらみんなそうだよ。<CR>一人じゃ何もできなかった
records.en_original: No one can say they did everything alone.
records.en_auxiliary: No one can say they did everything alone.
records.en: That would be true for everyone.<CR>None of us could have done anything alone.

records.jp: ここに集まったみんなだから成し遂げた。<CR>みんなで成し遂げたことは、みんなの手柄だよ
records.en_original: What we accomplished, we accomplished together. Everyone deserves their fair share of the credit.
records.en_auxiliary: What we accomplished, we accomplished together. Everyone deserves their fair share of the credit.
records.en: Everyone gathered here accomplished it together.<CR>What we did together belongs to all of us.

records.jp: ……そうだな
records.en_original: ...You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're right.
records.en: ...You're right.

records.jp: ここでの生活は、とても楽しかった
records.en_original: I really enjoyed my time here.
records.en_auxiliary: I really enjoyed my time here.
records.en: Life here was great fun for Kirara.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 思うようにいかないこともあったし、<CR>後悔することもあったけど……
records.en_original: There were things that didn't go as planned, and there are things I regret...
records.en_auxiliary: There were things that didn't go as planned, and there are things I regret...
records.en: There were things that didn't go as planned,<CR>and there are things I regret...

records.jp: ここでみんなと過ごせてよかった。<CR>それだけは自信をもって言える、偽りのない想いだ
records.en_original: But I'm glad to have spent time with everyone here. That I can say with total confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: But I'm glad to have spent time with everyone here. That I can say with total confidence.
records.en: But Kirara is glad she could spend this time with everyone.<CR>That feeling is honest, and Kirara can say it with confidence.

records.jp: じゃあ、その想いを持っていこう
records.en_original: Then take that feeling with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Then take that feeling with you.
records.en: Then take that feeling with you.

records.jp: その想いがあれば、<CR>きっと新しい世界でも楽しい人生が待ってる
records.en_original: As long as you hold on to that feeling, I'm sure you'll enjoy your life in the next world.
records.en_auxiliary: As long as you hold on to that feeling, I'm sure you'll enjoy your life in the next world.
records.en: With that feeling,<CR>a happy life surely awaits you in the new world.

records.jp: ……うむ
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 思えばきららも、使命だとか、責任だとか、<CR>そういう形もない何かに振り回されて生きてきた
records.en_original: Come to think of it, I spent much of my life guided by something ephemeral. A mission, or a feeling of responsibility.
records.en_auxiliary: Come to think of it, I spent much of my life guided by something ephemeral. A mission, or a feeling of responsibility.
records.en: Thinking back, Kirara too lived at the mercy of<CR>formless things like missions and responsibility.

records.jp: 新しい世界では……使命も何もない、<CR>一友人として再会できることを心より願う
records.en_original: I hope that when we meet in the new world, it's not as some part of a larger mission, but just as two friends.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope that when we meet in the new world, it's not as some part of a larger mission, but just as two friends.
records.en: In the new world, Kirara sincerely hopes<CR>we can meet again simply as friends, with no mission at all.

records.jp: ……うん。こちらこそ、きらら
records.en_original: Me too, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: Me too, Kirara.
records.en: Yeah. I hope so too, Kirara.

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 愛央に会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: Kirara wants to see Ao.

records.jp: きららは、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: Kirara believes in miracles.
